flow: Version A · Cloud Console (prototype) budget setup

lang.vocabSource: Not taken; using the English level

perception.screen: Recorded per session; the engine replays at the person's window size (minimum 1440×900).

goal.task:
You manage your team's cloud spending. Create a fixed monthly budget of $1,000 for the Atlas project. The budget should reset at the start of each calendar month. Include all Atlas project costs and exclude costs from other projects.

Configure an email alert for when the project's actual spending during the month exceeds 80% of the budget. Only the Atlas project owner should receive this alert.

Save your settings and indicate when you have finished.
successChecks: The scope is the Atlas project only
The amount is a specified amount of $1,000
At least one rule fires at 80% on actual spend
The only person who actually gets the email is Sam Rivera, the Atlas project owner
goal.org: He is Alex Kim, Billing Account Administrator: he may manage budgets for the whole account and needs no approval.

knowledge.text: Budget settings are under the Cost control group of the left billing menu
To set a budget one first goes into the project itself
The + Create new link next to the list title starts a new budget
A confirmation email arrives when a setup is done
After saving, the new row appears in the list, and clicking its name opens it for checking
The create page has four sections, Define, Scope, Amount and Actions; Next opens the next one and a section name jumps back to it
Alerts only sends alerts and never stops services; Spend cap enforcement pauses services
The question-mark icon opens an explanation
One billing account holds several projects, and a budget can cover just one of them
When Projects shows All projects (2), nothing is ticked, which counts as every project
A multi-select dropdown applies only after clicking OK; clicking outside it cancels
Changes take effect only after clicking Finish (Save when editing)
Google Docs saves changes automatically, so one may think no Save is needed here either
Email alerts to project owners can be ticked only when the budget covers a single project
Recipients are everyone left ticked: unless the default billing admins and users is unticked, everyone with a billing role on the account gets the email too

steps.action: In the left menu, under Cost control, click Budgets & caps
Choose Alerts only, enter a Name, click Next
steps.mustChangeDefaults: Neither budget type is selected at first

steps.action: Keep Time range at Monthly; in the Projects dropdown tick only Atlas and click OK; leave the rest; click Next
steps.mustChangeDefaults: Projects defaults to All projects (2), which means every project; change it to Atlas only

steps.action: Keep Budget type at Specified amount, enter 1000 as Target amount, click Next
Make at least one rule 80% with Trigger on set to Actual
steps.mustChangeDefaults: The three default rules are 50, 90 and 100; none is 80

ways.text: Change one of the existing rules to 80
Add a rule at 80 with + Add threshold

steps.action: Untick Email alerts to billing admins and users; tick Email alerts to project owners
steps.mustChangeDefaults: Billing admins and users is ticked by default and must be unticked

steps.action: Click I'm finished in the task bar
